r15-001.gate_key: cond_first | A2.2 | mcq | Choose the correct option: What ___ you do if the shop is closed tomorrow? | will

item.q: Choose the correct option: What ___ you do if the shop is closed tomorrow?
item.why: Possible future: *if* + Present Simple, *will* + base verb.

r15-002.gate_key: adverbs | B1.1 | gap | Write one word that fits: I ___ drink coffee in the evening because it keeps me awake. |

item.q: Write one word that fits: I ___ drink coffee in the evening because it keeps me awake.
item.why: A word for how often (*never, rarely*) goes before the main verb: *I never drink coffee in the evening.* *I don't drink* is correct too.
item.why_lv: Biežuma vārds (*never, rarely*) stāv pirms darbības vārda: *I never drink coffee in the evening.* Arī *I don't drink* ir *pareizi*.

r15-003.gate_key: future | B1.1 | gap | The film ___ at eight, so let's meet at seven. (start) |

item.q: The film ___ at eight, so let's meet at seven. (start)
answer_notes: A timetable or programme usually takes the present simple (*starts*). *will start* and *is starting* are correct too: they just do not sound like a fixed time in a programme.
Saraksts vai programma parasti ir Present Simple (*starts*). Arī *will start* un *is starting* ir pareizi, tikai neizklausās pēc noteikta laika programmā.
